annotations.title: Cross-chain volume by asset (stablecoins, tokenized stocks, ETH)

description: What moved cross-chain, by asset (2026-11-27): every bridge ASPERN stores (LayerZero OFT / Stargate, Across, Wormhole, Chainlink CCIP, the Base / OP / Arbitrum canonical bridges, Hyperliquid, deBridge, Relay) and Circle CCTP, grouped by the token that left its source chain, one asset per coin (USD₮0 and USDT are USDT, USDC.e is USDC). `classes`: stablecoins (USDC, USDT, PYUSD, USDe, DAI/USDS, EURC …, named by the promise, not the peg), tokenized stocks (a token our stock registry lists at that chain and address, with its issuer: xStocks, Ondo, Backed, Robinhood, Dinari …; a ticker-like symbol alone is never a stock), ETH, other. `assets`: largest by VALUE first (USD at the source hour; unpriced counted in Tx only), then Tx, each split by bridge. `state`: read, not_yet_read or unavailable. Never says who moved it, that an AI agent acted, or that anything was autonomous. FREE.
